description: An uncalled template still enforces the fixed arity of preceding-tokens. (Engine §4.4.)

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {_}
%emits $
%stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%rule unused(@X) @X
%conditions $.preceding-tokens(A).value = ""
```
